from meta.sas.tools.refresh_recovery_decay import refresh

    agent="Logos IV",
    dir_path="storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons",
    derived_out_path="storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/recovery_decay_cps_v1_logos_iv.json",
    panel_out_path="storage/shared/meta/sas/dashboard/recovery_decay_logos_iv_v1.json"
)
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
